key_insight: MM-KG builds an explicit, multimodal knowledge graph that connects patient evidence to biomedical concepts so clinical LLMs can use and trace the exact relation a question needs.
clinical_relevance: This approach may improve clinical question answering and prediction by making patient evidence, external knowledge, and their interaction separable, testable, and easier to audit.
method: Convert EHR text, imaging, genomic, and biospecimen data into typed observations.
Align observations to UMLS and link them to a biomedical knowledge graph with route-prioritized matching.
Retrieve a compact query-specific subgraph for use by a large language model or graph neural network.
evidence_signal: Across MIMIC-IV and ADNI, the combined patient-plus-knowledge setting showed strong interaction gains, including +0.194 AUROC on MIMIC and +0.299 on ADNI, with query-conditioned retrieval reaching 0.731 AUROC using 6.8x less context.
watch_item: Results depend on accurate modality harmonization and alignment; if the retrieved relation is missing or mislinked, performance can fall back to baseline.
paper_title: Aligning Multimodal Patient Evidence with Biomedical Knowledge Graphs for Clinical LLMs
